name: Gael
source:
Age: 28 years
Atributte: Demigod (living being)

The Warrior Saint, great-grandson of the God of War, Ambrósio. Gael had both of his parents massacred by Erester, together with the village where he lived, being the only one spared. Since then, he used all at his divine power to stop Erester, gaining fame in the kingdom of Alba in the process. Gael had a burning hatred for Erester, but his attitude changed to a drastic indifference since their last battle. He tells Erester to shut up whenever theirs conversations go beyond necessary.
